method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Corning strikes another multibillion-dollar AI deal. What the new Amazon pact means for the stock
Equities.summary: Amazon joins the laundry list of partnerships Corning has secured in 2026, which includes Meta Platforms and Nvidia.
Equities.reason: Reinforces the AI 'picks-and-shovels' theme (data-center supply chain). Positive for tech and industrial suppliers but single-stock focus limits relevance.

Equities.title: Stocks rally as investors dive back into tech; oil slips
Equities.reason: Broad-market buyback into tech after recent sell-off — signals risk-on bias and a rebound in AI/chip-led leadership. High relevance as a market-regime read.

Equities.title: Asian tech stocks rebound after Wall Street embraces AI once more
Equities.summary: Chipmaker-dominant markets rally after sell-off on Monday
Equities.reason: Regional confirmation of the same AI/chip-led rebound — reinforces global nature of the tech recovery and breadth implications.

Equities.title: Apollo and Blackstone raise $35bn in chip financing deal for Anthropic
Equities.summary: Transaction is one of largest private credit fundraisings, fuelling Claude maker’s AI growth plans
Equities.reason: Large private-capital financing directly fuels AI infrastructure growth — significant capital flow into AI thematic, materially bullish for related equities and chip demand.

Equities.title: ‘Picks and shovels’ companies profit from data centre scramble
Equities.summary: Caterpillar and Hochtief among the once-staid industrial stocks lifted by the AI boom
Equities.reason: Highlights rotation into industrials/infrastructure beneficiaries of the AI data-centre buildout — supports breadth beyond pure tech names.

Equities.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang declines Senate testimony on AI, China and exports
Equities.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren said Nvidia’s CEO should answer questions publicly as lawmakers scrutinize AI chip sales to China and export controls.
Equities.reason: Regulatory/geo-political risk around chip exports and China could restrain investor enthusiasm for the AI hardware complex — a meaningful counter-signal to the rally.

Equities.title: Apple partnering with Google and Nvidia for most advanced AI model
Equities.summary: Apple's artificial intelligence strategy took center stage at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif.
Equities.reason: Major tech incumbents aligning on advanced AI models is a strong bullish catalyst for the sector and for chip/cloud infrastructure demand.

Equities.title: Stocks are recovering from a sell-off — but even bullish investors warn of a bumpy ride ahead
Equities.summary: Stocks edged higher on Tuesday, marking a tentative recovery from a bout of volatility led by an aggressive sell-off of global technology shares.
Equities.reason: Captures the tentative nature of the rebound — positive near-term but highlights ongoing volatility and downside risks to sustained rallies.

Equities.title: Chip rebound sparks hedging flurry from traders
Equities.summary: Despite the overall bearish sentiment on the cohort, traders put a few bullish bets on potential semiconductor winners.
Equities.reason: Shows market participants hedging — supports a recovery in chips but with active risk management, limiting runaway upside.

Equities.title: Korean Stocks Jump 8% as Chip Shares Rebound After AI Selloff
Equities.reason: Strong regional equity move led by semiconductors — reinforces the narrative that chips are leading the rebound across markets.

Equities.title: Wall Street Is Rushing to Fund the AI Bonanza in Every Conceivable Way
Equities.reason: Evidence of broad capital chasing the AI theme (VC, PE, credit, public markets) — strong structural bullish flow into equities tied to AI.

Equities.title: Citi’s Chew Sees Aggressive Short-Selling Positions in US Stocks
Equities.reason: Elevated short interest is a meaningful risk to rallies and signals asymmetric downside risk if sentiment shifts; moderates bullish interpretation.

Equities.title: GSK to buy US cancer biotech Nuvalent for $10.6bn
Equities.summary: New chief Luke Miels makes his mark at GSK with one of UK drugmakers’ biggest deals
Equities.reason: Large M&A deal within pharma — supports dealmaking backdrop and sector-specific upside, but narrower market impact than AI/chips theme.

Equities.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Rise Most in Two Months on AI Dip-Buying
Equities.reason: Shows AI-driven flows extending into EM equities — reinforces broader, multi-market appetite for AI exposure.

Rates.title: Taiwan Five-Year Yields at Highest Since 2008 on Cash, Rate View
Rates.reason: Direct report of a sharp rise in Taiwan 5-year yields — clear bond selloff / higher-for-longer local rates signal. Regionally important EM/Asia rates move that weighs on fixed income; relevance elevated but regional (not global) so not maximal.

Rates.title: Treasury Market Is Telling Kevin Warsh Rates Need to Be Higher
Rates.reason: Explicit market signal that U.S. Treasury pricing implies higher policy rates — strong negative for bond prices (yields up). Broad US rates signal with high market-moving relevance, so given a large negative directional weight and high relevance.

Rates.title: Investors spy a tipping point for bonds after geopolitics shreds old playbooks
Rates.reason: Article frames a structural reassessment in bond markets driven by geopolitics and risk premia — implies greater volatility and potential for higher yields/selling pressure. Broad thematic piece so relevance above average.

Rates.title: Indonesia’s Bond Selloff Extends as Five-Year Note Yield Surges
Rates.reason: EM sovereign bond selloff with 5-year yield spike — negative for bond prices and indicative of wider emerging market rate pressure. Regionally relevant and reinforces global risk-off / higher-yield narrative.

Rates.title: Bank of Canada: Policy on hold as external shocks bite – Rabobank
Rates.summary: Rabobank’s Molly Schwartz and Christian Lawrence expect the Bank of Canada (BoC) to keep its policy rate at 2.25% at the June 10 meeting and through year-end.
Rates.reason: Forecast that BoC will hold policy rate — modestly supportive for Canadian bonds (no further tightening anticipated). Impact is localized and lower signal versus global Treasury/yield stories, so given low relevance and small positive direction.

FX.title: US Dollar: Rangebound resilience with upside risks – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong notes that the Dollar is consolidating after payroll-driven gains, with Asia FX diverging on policy signals and flows. The bank has removed its final Fed rate cut and now expects no easing through 2026, alongside higher 10Y y
FX.reason: Bank note that Fed cuts removed and higher 10y yields -> reinforces USD strength / higher-for-longer rates; large FX-market implication for USD and dollar crosses.

FX.title: US Dollar Index: Consolidation phase before data – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes that risk assets and Asian currencies have stabilised, but expects the US Dollar (USD) to stay supported on dips as markets await key US data and central bank meetings.
FX.reason: Explicit USD-support view from major bank ahead of data/CB events -> supports USD on dips, clear near-term dollar-positive signal for FX flows.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index Price Forecast: Rising 20-day EMA backs bullish bias
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) faces slight selling in the European trading session on Tuesday due to renewed hopes of a potential deal between the United States (US) and Iran.
FX.reason: Technical piece pointing to bullish USD bias (rising 20‑day EMA). Technical analysis given lower relevance per framework.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Weak against US Dollar despite BoJ hike bets – MUFG
FX.summary: Lee Hardman at MUFG observes that the Japanese Yen remains under pressure as USD/JPY trades back above 160.00, with markets almost fully pricing a BoJ rate hike at the June 16 meeting.
FX.reason: USD/JPY above 160 despite BoJ hike pricing -> strong USD vs JPY narrative; important for G10 FX and risk/yield transmissions.

FX.title: Japanese Yen steadies near recent lows as ceasefire, Japan intervention threats offset
FX.summary: USD/JPY trades around 160.15 on Tuesday at the time of writing, remaining close to its highest level since April 30 despite a broadly neutral intraday performance.
FX.reason: Notes on intervention threats vs ceasefire reduce one-sided move but pair remains near multi‑month highs -> keeps USD/JPY tension and intervention risk priced in.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Current account gains contrast with weak JPY – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur highlights that USD/JPY has climbed back above 160, near multi-decade highs, even as Japan’s current account surplus has improved to its highest level since 1996 and 5.6% of GDP.
FX.reason: Fundamental divergence: strong external balances but continued JPY weakness -> reinforces dominant narrative of FX flows/yield differentials driving USD/JPY higher.

FX.title: Euro trims losses on ECB tightening hopes, mild US Dollar weakness
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) ticks up for the second consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday to pare some of last week’s losses.
FX.reason: ECB tightening hopes driving EUR gains against USD -> clear near-term euro-positive / dollar-negative signal for EURUSD flows.

FX.title: Euro: Downtrend against US Dollar targets lower supports – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe EUR/USD price action as short-term consolidation between 1.1505 and 1.1555 after last week’s sharp drop.
FX.reason: Bank highlights short‑term EUR weakness vs USD after sharp drop; reinforces USD-support narrative in near term.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Gradual downside toward 0.7000 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann see AUD/USD stabilising intraday between 0.7015 and 0.7065 after a brief dip, but retain a negative 1–3 week bias.
FX.reason: Clear USD‑positive bias vs AUD for 1–3 weeks -> contributes to USD-support / commodity‑FX underperformance narrative.

FX.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Stalls below 0.8000 with bulls still in control
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) posts marginal losses against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on Tuesday, with bulls capped near the 0.8000 psychological level. Downside attempts, however, remain contained above 0.7965, so far keeping the pair steady at two-month highs for now.
FX.reason: Technical/short‑term USD marginal weakness vs CHF; technical focus reduces relevance but still flags CHF support and USD chop.

FX.title: Swiss Franc: Weakens against Euro on softer Swiss rates – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes EUR/CHF has drifted back to 0.92 as Swiss rates lag global moves and markets price three European Central Bank (ECB) hikes over the next 10–12 months.
FX.reason: Rate differentials between Switzerland and Eurozone driving EUR/CHF higher -> relevant to cross‑currency flows and EUR strength narrative.

FX.title: Indian Rupee rebounds as oil prices tumble on US-Iran deal hopes
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) recovers against the US Dollar (USD) at open on Tuesday after a sharp decline the previous day.
FX.reason: INR rebound linked to oil price move and geopolitical hopes -> direct FX transmission (INR vs USD) with moderate relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar rebounds from two-month lows
FX.summary: USD/CAD halts its four-day winning streak, pulling back after reaching a two-month high of 1.39613 in the previous day and trading around 1.3940 during the European hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: CAD recovery vs USD after multi‑day USD gains -> relevant for commodity‑FX and USD crosses, moderate relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar holds gains following China Trade Balance data
FX.summary: NZD/USD remains stronger for the second successive day, trading around 0.5830 during the early European hours on Tuesday.
FX.reason: NZD strength vs USD after China data -> localized EM/commodity FX move with limited market‑wide impact.

FX.title: Why is the British Pound struggling when the BoE is considering rate hikes?
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) is struggling as mounting political uncertainty and deteriorating economic indicators complicate the United Kingdom's outlook.
FX.reason: GBP weakness despite BoE‑hike expectations points to domestic/political headwinds -> negative for GBP/USD (i.e., dollar relatively stronger).

FX.title: Korea Readies On-Site FX Inspections to Curb Won Speculation
FX.reason: Authorities prepping on‑site FX inspections implies policy action to rein in won speculation -> supports KRW / reduces one‑way USD/EMFX moves; relevant to regional FX flows.

FX.title: India’s RBI Offers Discounted FX Swaps at 1.5% to Draw Inflows
FX.reason: RBI offering discounted FX swaps is a direct policy tool to attract inflows and support INR -> material EMFX policy intervention signal.

FX.title: Indonesia May Hike Rate Again to Shield Currency, Analysts Say
FX.reason: Rate‑hike prospects aimed at protecting the rupiah -> clear central‑bank/FX policy transmission supporting EMFX, moderate relevance.

FX.title: Sterling rises against euro, dollar as risk sentiment improves
FX.reason: Market report of GBP gains vs USD/EUR tied to risk sentiment -> direct FX move with clear implications for USD crosses and risk‑pair dynamics.

Commodities.title: Gold: Uptrend delayed on hawkish Fed repricing – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC’s FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong reports that Gold has come under pressure after breaking below its 200-day moving average on a more hawkish Fed narrative and oil-led inflation fears.
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed repricing is a clear negative driver for gold (higher real rates, USD support). OCBC note flags technical break and oil-led inflation fears — a broad macro narrative weighing on bullion. High relevance due to Fed-led macro impulse.

Commodities.title: Gold flat lines below $4,350 as bulls remain on the sidelines amid hawkish Fed bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) remains confined in a narrow range through the first half of the European session on Tuesday and remains within striking distance of its lowest level since March 23, set the previous day.
Commodities.reason: Price action stuck near recent lows with hawkish-Fed positioning cited — reinforces the prevailing negative near-term gold narrative. Technical/flow note => moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Neither China nor India: This is the country’s central bank that has bought more Gold this year
Commodities.summary: Poland’s central bank was the top Gold buyer in April among its peers, consolidating its position as one of the world’s most active sovereigns that accumulate the precious metal.
Commodities.reason: Central-bank buying is a structural support for gold prices. Poland’s active accumulation is constructive but country-specific; increases relevance modestly as part of broader demand narrative.

Commodities.title: Gold prices today, Tuesday, June 9: Prices settling into a lower range ahead of inflation reports
Commodities.reason: Intraday price note citing consolidation into a lower range ahead of inflation data — short-term, market-monitoring relevance (technical/flow), not a major fundamental shift.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains above $68.50 despite ongoing bearish bias
Commodities.summary: XAG/USD extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around $68.60 per troy ounce during the European hours on Tuesday. Silver is retaining a bearish near-term bias as it holds below both the nine-day and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).
Commodities.reason: Technical note: silver retains near-term bearish bias despite a small bounce. As a price/technical piece, relevance capped; still signals downside risk in precious metals complex tied to same Fed/yield backdrop as gold.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas storage capacity increased slightly in 2025
Commodities.summary: Underground working natural gas storage capacity in the Lower 48 states increased slightly in 2025, according to our latest data, with growth concentrated in the South Central and Mountain regions. Underground natural gas storage provides a source of energy wh
Commodities.reason: Slight rise in storage capacity implies modestly higher potential supply flexibility — negative for natural gas price structure but incremental. EIA data is primary-source and relevant to seasonal supply/demand balance.

Commodities.title: Analysis-Alberta pitches cheap natural gas for data center boom, at odds with Canada's clean power aims
Commodities.reason: Policy/industry push to expand gas-fired power/data-center demand could support regional gas consumption. Effect is demand-side supportive but localized and gradual, so low-to-moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Copper Holds Gain With Easing Iran Tensions, China Data in Focus
Commodities.reason: Easing geopolitical risk and China data focus are positive for industrial metals demand and prices. Bloomberg note reflects the dominant macro drivers for copper (China demand + risk premium).

Commodities.title: Oil: War-risk pricing holds steady – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s Global Strategist Michael Every notes that Oil prices were little changed after another sharp Middle East escalation involving Israel and Iran, as markets reverted to an ‘as you were’ stance.
Commodities.reason: Rabobank frames oil as maintaining a war-risk premium but with markets normalizing after spikes — mildly supportive for prices given persistent geopolitical risk premium.

Commodities.title: A Rush to Stockpile Oil Will Keep Prices Higher for Longer
Commodities.reason: Major thematic: strategic and commercial stockpiling amplifies underlying demand and supports a structurally higher oil price path. This is a material macro driver for oil and raises relevance significantly.

Commodities.title: Kuwait Offers Oil to Asian Buyers for First Time Since War Began
Commodities.reason: Resumption of Kuwaiti cargoes to Asia could modestly alleviate regional tightness — a supply-flow signal that is slightly bearish for prices, though contextual significance depends on volumes/duration.

Commodities.title: Colombia’s Beleaguered Oil Sector Eyeing Comeback in Venezuela
Commodities.reason: Potential revival of Colombian/Venezuelan supply could add to medium-term crude availability. Relevant to oil fundamentals but uncertainty and timeline dampen immediate impact.

Commodities.title: Sugar Swings as Traders Weigh Brazil Output Against Deficit Risk
Commodities.reason: Balanced story on Brazilian output vs deficit risk — introduces volatility and two-way risk for sugar. Moderate relevance as a fundamental supply/demand consideration for softs.

Crypto.title: Blame bitcoin's tumble on rising inflation, not Strategy, 10xResearch argues
Crypto.reason: Frames bitcoin weakness as driven by macro (rising inflation) rather than idiosyncratic flows — negative for crypto risk assets because inflation/yields pressure carries into reduced BTC demand.

Crypto.title: MetaMask launches AI agent wallet with built-in security for crypto trades
Crypto.reason: Product innovation that improves UX and on-chain security — positive for adoption and trading flows, supports liquidity and institutional/product development.

Crypto.title: Circle debuts cirBTC on Ethereum to challenge Coinbase in the wrapped bitcoin market
Crypto.reason: New wrapped-BTC product from a major stablecoin issuer increases on-chain BTC liquidity and custody competition — constructive for BTC/ETH markets and ecosystem flows.

Crypto.title: Coinbase and Cardless unveil credit card backed by stablecoins
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin-backed consumer product expands real-world utility and demand for stablecoins — positive for onramps, network effects and stablecoin volumes.

Crypto.title: Humanity Protocol token crashes more than 80% after a $32 million private-key hack
Crypto.reason: Large private-key compromise and severe token crash are a direct security event — materially negative for trust, risk premia and short-term risk appetite in crypto.

Crypto.title: Aave chief defends protocol's 'resilience' after $8.45 billion bank run
Crypto.reason: Very large DeFi liquidity/run event undermines confidence in decentralized money markets and raises systemic risk concerns — strongly negative for DeFi tokens and broader crypto risk sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bitmine bought the dip, making its biggest ether purchase in 2026 as prices tanked
Crypto.reason: Miner/treasury accumulation represents buyer demand for ETH during a selloff — supportive for ETH price and on-chain narrative.

Crypto.title: Strategy buys 1,550 bitcoin one week after selling $2.5 million of coins
Crypto.reason: Significant corporate/institutional accumulation of BTC increases demand and signals continued institutional participation — positive for BTC price discovery and sentiment.

Crypto.title: A crucial bitcoin market indicator is signaling that the worst of the crypto crash might be over
Crypto.reason: Market-structure indicator suggesting stabilization would reduce tail-risk pricing and help sentiment — modestly positive for market outlook.

Crypto.title: CME is letting traders bet on bitcoin volatility, not price, and two firms have already placed bets
Crypto.reason: New institutional volatility product broadens risk-management tools and derivative liquidity — constructive for institutional participation and market depth.

Crypto.title: The startup killer: Ledger CTO says the EU's crushing compliance costs are choking Web3 innovation
Crypto.reason: Stricter EU compliance costs described as stifling startups — a regulatory headwind that can slow innovation and adoption in a major market.

Crypto.title: Convicted FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried files formal request for Trump pardon
Crypto.summary: The co-founder of the now defunct FTX crypto exchange is currently serving a 25-year federal prison sentence.
Crypto.reason: High-profile legal/political development that keeps negative public attention on crypto governance and reputational risk — limited direct market impact but a small negative for sentiment.
